description: Search IconSaga icons by meaning, in the user's own language (English, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Indonesian or mixed). Also takes an icon name as UI icon sets write it (arrow-right, circle-check, shopping-cart, trash-2, HomeIcon) and returns the matching icon first. Several things in one query ("calendar clock schedule"): when no icon has every word, the icons that have the most of the words come first (relaxed "any-words"; each result lists the words it matched in "matched", and "unmatched" the words no icon has). Returns icon ids, labels, versions, styles and licence per icon.

lang.description: Language of the labels in the answer: en, th, es, pt-BR, fr, de, ja, zh-Hans, ko or id (regions and names such as pt, zh-CN, ja-JP or "Japanese" also work). Default: the language of the query

query.description: What the icon should show, e.g. "invoice", "ลูกศรซ้าย", "carrito de compras", "地図のピン", "home บ้าน"

set.description: Only icons of this set (see list_sets)

style.description: Only icons available in this style

name: search_icons
title: Search icons
